title: Chumash people - Wikipedia
text: May 30, 2026 - No native speakers remain, although the dialects are well documented in the unpublished fieldnotes of linguist John Peabody Harrington. Especially well documented are the Barbareño, Ineseño, Ventureño and Obispeño languages within the Chumashan language family, which is a language isolate.

title: Chumash Story & Song - Ojai Music Festival
text: April 5, 2023 - These early-morning songs, performed beneath the canopy of oaks of the outdoor amphitheater at the Ojai Valley School’s Upper Campus, introduce students to the history of the Chumash people. Stories and songs help us to know that we must care for our world, and every living being. Music and storytelling continue to play a role in the culture and traditions of the native people who were the first to call the Ojai Valley their home.
